name: Ryoujoku Dousoukai
source:
In order to fulfill what he wished to do at the age of students, protagonist invites former girl classmates to a false "alumni association". He is about to commit each girl one by one in accordance with his memories.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
为了完成学生时代的愿望，主角邀请以前的女同学加入一个虚假的“校友会”。他准备按照自己的记忆，将每一个女孩都一一委屈。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-november-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
